summary: Lane County, OR summit in the Willamette NF: L-5 cab dated 1934 (a 1933 item says a house was finished); removed or destroyed 1965; ground site, no remains described.

facts.status_note: Cab removed (register) or destroyed (Firelookout.com) in 1965; no source describes what remains

visit.trail_note: No tower or cab remains to climb; no source describes the summit today or whether it is open to visitors

events.note: Eugene Guard, October 14, 1933, as quoted by Forest Lookouts: a telephone line being completed from the Burnt Top lookout station to Horse Lake ranger station

Register and Firelookout.com date the L-5 cab to 1934. Forest Lookouts quotes a Eugene Guard item from November 8, 1933 saying a crew had completed a lookout house and telephone line; the years conflict
US Geological Survey station description, 1955: station mark at the center of the single-story USFS lookout
Register: cab removed in 1965. Firelookout.com: destroyed in 1965. Forest Lookouts: lookout removed in 1965
Registered April 24, 2011 as US 943, OR 301; nominated by Ray Kresek

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register and Firelookout.com say 1934; Forest Lookouts quotes a November 8, 1933 Eugene Guard item saying a lookout house was completed. The story reports both and does not pick one.
Register says the cab was removed in 1965; Firelookout.com says destroyed in 1965. Same year, different wording.

notes_for_editor: Brief access was unknown and no access source was found, so no access key. Build year conflicts (1933 newspaper vs 1934 register). No source describes remains or visitor access at the summit today. Forest Lookouts' weebly page includes a 1955 US Geological Survey station description (survey mark at lookout center) used in the story. Verification 2026-10-09: the 1933 Eugene Guard dates were confirmed on the page; the story now places the 1933 lookout house on Burnt Top mountain and the survey mark at the lookout, without the summit claim.
